page_title: OSA 2-0 CAD | Osasuna v Cadiz CF 17/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+5' David Garcia (Osasuna) is penalised.
90+1' 2 - 0 Goal! Jesus Areso provides Ante Budimir (Osasuna) with a nice pass inside the box. It allows him to finish with a precise effort into the bottom right corner. 2:0.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
90' Lucas Pires (Cadiz) creates a yard of space for himself and tries an effort from distance, but it's blocked.
88' Pablo Ibanez (Osasuna) is given a fully deserved yellow card.
87' Moi Gomez (Osasuna) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.

87' Pablo Ibanez (Osasuna) latches on to a precise pass and finds himself one-on-one with the keeper. He fires a low shot towards the left side of the net, but Conan Ledesma leaps like a salmon to deny him.
86' Osasuna force their opponents to concede a corner.
84' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
78' A substitution has been made. Ruben Garcia goes off and Lucas Torro (Osasuna) comes on.
78' Jagoba Arrasate has decided to substitute Aimar Oroz and he is replaced by Kike Barja (Osasuna).
76' Sergio Guardiola (Cadiz) comes onto the pitch after Jorge Mere signals to the bench that he cannot continue any longer after picking up an injury.
76' Juanmi (Cadiz) beats the defender to the ball in the box and shoots, but the ball flashes just wide of the right post.
72' Robert Navarro goes off the pitch and Darwin Machis (Cadiz) comes on.

70' Jon Moncayola (Osasuna) receives a quality pass and releases a rocket of a shot from distance, but his amazing effort goes just wide of the left post! The goalkeeper probably wouldn't have saved this one.
67' Jagoba Arrasate prepares a substitution. Johan Mojica is replaced by Juan Cruz (Osasuna).
64' Today's match ends for Chris Ramos who will be replaced by Maximiliano Gomez (Cadiz).
64' Substitution. Diadie Samassekou (Cadiz) has come on for Gonzalo Escalante.

63' 1 - 0 A perfect lofted pass from Ruben Garcia finds Ante Budimir (Osasuna), who jumps highest and steers a close-range header into the left side of the goal. His effort was both strong and precise, and Conan Ledesma had no chance of stopping that. 1:0.
60' Jagoba Arrasate decides to make a substitution. Iker Munoz will be replaced by Pablo Ibanez (Osasuna).
60' Ruben Pena will be replaced by Jesus Areso (Osasuna).

60' Poor effort! The corner picks out Victor Chust (Cadiz) completely unmarked in the centre of the box. He has time to pick his spot with the header but makes a mess of it, sending the ball well wide of the left post.
60' Ruben Alcaraz (Cadiz) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
59' Cadiz CF restart play with a quick free kick.

58' Jon Moncayola (Osasuna) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Cadiz CF earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
55' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) rises above the defenders and places a towering header towards the roof of the net, but Conan Ledesma is prepared and leaps to thwart him.
55' The attendance is 19525.
50' Cadiz CF have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
46' Osasuna force a corner. They send men into the box.
46' Mauricio Pellegrino makes a half-time substitution. Ivan Alejo (Cadiz) comes on in place of Joseba Zaldua.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+2' The match has reached half-time.
45+2' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Ruben Alcaraz (Cadiz), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
42' Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) is awarded a yellow card. The referee showed him no mercy.
42' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
41' Lucas Pires (Cadiz) sends a cross into the box, but Sergio Herrera comes off his line to gather the ball.
41' Cadiz CF take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
39' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
39' Ruben Pena (Osasuna) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
33' A decent effort by Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) from a close-range free kick! His attempt flies narrowly over the crossbar.
31' Yellow card. Lucas Pires (Cadiz) goes into the referee's book after a bad challenge. Lucas Pires (Cadiz) will miss the next game.
26' Johan Mojica (Osasuna) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Francisco Maeso had an easy-decision to make.
25' Chris Ramos (Cadiz) drives into the box and hits a tremendous shot that, unluckily for him, flashes just wide of the left post.
24' Joseba Zaldua (Cadiz) picks up a yellow card.
22' Total attempts – 2:1. The current number of shots on goal is 0:1.
16' Chris Ramos (Cadiz) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Francisco Maeso blows his whistle for a foul.
12' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) takes a first-time shot from inside the box, but his poor effort flies way wide of the right post.
10' Iker Munoz (Osasuna) latches on to a loose ball on the edge of the box and fires in a first-time shot on goal, but the effort lacks accuracy and flies high over the bar.
10' Ruben Pena (Osasuna) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
8' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Johan Mojica (Osasuna) but poses no threat.
8' Fali (Cadiz) sends a long ball in, but Sergio Herrera comfortably gathers the ball.
6' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Cadiz CF was in an offside position.

5' Fali (Cadiz) creates himself some space inside the goalmouth and connects with the free kick. His accurate header would have probably ended up in the roof of the net, but Sergio Herrera pulls off a superb reflex save to thwart him.
4' Iker Munoz (Osasuna) performs a sliding tackle but catches his opponent's legs. The referee blows his whistle for an infringement. There is a free kick near the sideline to Cadiz CF.
4' David Garcia (Osasuna) sends a long ball forward to Ruben Pena, but he put too much power and the chance is gone. The ball goes out of play and Cadiz CF will have a goal kick.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are on the pitch and Osasuna will have the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Francisco Maeso.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
